name: Local thread
why: A local thread, from the folder it opens to the archive that closes it
ideal: A local thread loads a small folder, runs its first command fast, ends pushed and is archived by its starter.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Claude Code Docs: Continue local sessions from any device with Remote Control

steps.name: Folder
steps.rule: A local thread loads little folder context at start.

steps.name: Start
steps.rule: The first command runs within two minutes.

steps.name: End
steps.rule: A thread ends with no uncommitted or unpushed work.

steps.name: Archive
steps.rule: A session is archived by its starter when its task ends.
